note: Consumes attacker-controlled config bytes one character at a time into the lexer state.
A '$' followed by '{' diverts the lexer into variable parsing and changes how the current token is finalized.
The lexer backs up after already advancing past the current character; this safety obligation depends on there still being a previous byte to step back over.
When the input is at the beginning of the mapped buffer, decrementing pos moves it before the buffer and later dereferences can read out of bounds.
